name: streamvessel-log-worker
description: StreamVessel log agent as a Cloudflare Worker: OpenSearch _bulk receiver -> Queue -> presigned upload

SV_CLIENT_ID.description: **Required.** Client id of your StreamVessel log agent: `sva_` followed by 22 characters. Create the agent in StreamVessel first.

SV_CLIENT_SECRET.description: **Required.** Secret of that log agent: starts with `svas_`. StreamVessel shows it only once, when you create the agent.

COLLECTOR_PASSWORD.description: **Required.** A new password App Platform will use to send logs to this Worker. At least 16 characters, for example the output of `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it: you enter it again in App Platform.

COLLECTOR_USER.description: User name App Platform will use with `COLLECTOR_PASSWORD`. Default: `streamvessel`.

SV_SERVER.description: Your StreamVessel address. Keep the default unless you run your own StreamVessel.

SV_INSTANCE.description: Folder name for this Worker's files in your bucket: letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, up to 63 characters.

LOG_QUEUE.description: Queue that holds logs until they are uploaded.

DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE.description: Queue that keeps batches that could not be uploaded after many retries.
